project_type: Next.js 14 dapp + Hardhat blockchain, TypeScript monorepo, Web3 stack (wagmi/viem, MetaMask)
build_system: npm workspaces, hardhat for contracts, next.js dev server on port 3000
test_framework: hardhat test (Mocha), no Jest for dapp yet
build_command: npm run blockchain:compile && npm run build (next build if exists)
test_command: npm run test:cafeswap (contract tests), manual browser testing for UI
verification_instructions: 1. Deploy contracts to Sepolia testnet. 2. Verify ABIs in dapp/src/lib/contracts/ match deployed artifacts. 3. Run UI manually: load /lote page, check rendering matches design.md. 4. Test MetaMask integration: connect wallet, create/edit lot events.
snapshot_or_generated_files: Smart contract ABIs are manually exported to dapp/src/lib/contracts/ after compilation. Commands: hardhat compile generates artifacts/, then copy ABI JSON to contracts.ts.
environment_constraints: Sepolia testnet only (hardcoded in hardhat.config.js). Design system from design.md must be followed strictly (kraft paper #f5f1e7, green #1f6440). No external UI libraries — inline CSS only. MetaMask required for Web3 interaction.
contribution_requirements: From AGENTS.md (inferred): commit small, testable units; use pt-BR for UI labels; follow design.md tokens for colors and spacing; include mock data patterns from existing pages like producer/page.tsx.
key_patterns: 1. Page components use 'use client' + useState for mock data (see producer/page.tsx). 2. Types in dapp/src/types/agrochain.ts (CoffeeBatch, CacaoBatch, TraceNode patterns). 3. Contracts follow AgroChainPayments pattern (events for state changes, mappings for storage, view functions for reads). 4. Design tokens: --fundo (#f5f1e7), --texto-1 (#1e2a22), --verde-600 (#1f6440), --ouro (#b8912a) for status colors. 5. Sidebar links must route to new pages.
relevant_files: dapp/src/types/agrochain.ts — existing types (CoffeeBatch, CacaoBatch, TraceNode, ComplianceResult)
dapp/src/app/producer/page.tsx — page structure, mock data, styling pattern, wagmi usage
blockchain/contracts/AgroChainPayments.sol — escrow pattern, order state machine, events
design.md — color tokens, spacing, typography (Georgia serif for titles)
directory_structure: blockchain/contracts/ — Solidity contracts; blockchain/scripts/ — deployment scripts; dapp/src/app/ — Next.js pages; dapp/src/lib/contracts/ — ABIs and utilities; dapp/src/types/ — TypeScript interfaces; dapp/src/components/ — UI components (minimal); .agents/tasks/ — task artifacts.
